title: ResearchOS Hypothesis
description: A hypothesis. Records written before the 2026-10-21 hypothesis-cycle work (state/hypotheses.jsonl and state/hypotheses.d/2026-10-21-3990b64b4fdb.jsonl, listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json) predate the four cycle fields; every record in a newer file must carry them. The fields exist so that a loop can run without controlled experiments: derived_from_evidence_ids records which observations GENERATED the hypothesis (those observations can never also count as its support), refutation_condition states before the fact what observation would kill it, and next_observations says what to look for next. See docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md sections 3 (S4-S7) and 5.

round.description: Loop round that produced this record. Required for every hypothesis in a file not listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json.

derived_from_evidence_ids.description: EVDs used to GENERATE the hypothesis. A relation from one of these observations is marked derived_from=true and is excluded from the support count (docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md section 5).

refutation_condition.description: What observation would refute the hypothesis, written before it is looked for. All three strings must be non-empty.

next_observations.description: Concrete observations to collect next. Non-empty for every hypothesis in a non-exempt file; the search planner (S7) turns these into queries.
